name: Crowdcast
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Crowdcast, host a small interactive live event and publish a replay. The hard boundary is live-event media, registration, chat, questions, analytics, and community audience, plus real-time media infrastructure and reliability.
